name: Shakhunya-Tonshaevo Gas Pipeline (Nizhny Novgorod Oblast)

values.RouteNotes: No route geometry published; endpoints only (Shakhunya to Tonshaevo, northern Nizhny Novgorod Oblast). Downstream of the Obkhod-Shakhunya trunk.

researcher_notes: Not in roster (checked GGIT working CSV for shakhun/tonshae/obkhod/tonkino: no hit); distinct from the GRS Obkhod branch (30 km) and Obkhod-Shakhunya (30.6 km, completed 23 Sep 2026 = separate candidate). Threshold: (a) sponsor Gazprom (regional program signed 2021 by governor Nikitin and Gazprom's Miller; Gazprom investments in northern-district program per gipernn; local builder/operator presumably Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Nizhny Novgorod, not stated for this segment, so Owner/Parent kept at Gazprom PJSC, medium); (b) Shakhunya to Tonshaevo, Nizhny Novgorod Oblast; (c) concrete step = construction underway, 38.4% ready at 21 Jan 2026 (regional energy minister Kurenkov to the Legislative Assembly committee), commissioning planned 2027; governor said 23 Sep 2026 that Tonshaevo is to be gasified next year; (d) length 32.1 km sourced (>=25). Length/status sources niann.ru and vz-nn.ru both trace to one NTA-Privolzhye report of the 21 Jan 2026 committee meeting, so NOT independent; mk.ru, gipernn (Kommersant-Privolzhye) and pravda-nn independently confirm the line exists/is planned but give no length. Single validated source suffices; tier medium (construction status, single-origin length). Sponsor leg is by program attribution rather than a per-segment contract: a reviewer may prefer monitor. ProposalYear 2025 inferred from gipernn (design 2025-2026); weak. Fields left blank because unsourced: Capacity, Diameter, cost, PipelineType (inter-settlement/distribution-scale, vocabulary choice left to reviewer), FIDStatus (not applicable under construction). Owner refs belong on the operators/owners tab. Route: none found; no coordinates invented.
